children: China healthcare platform's Q2 revenue fell 28% yr/yr amid asset-light business transition
Company reported wider net and adjusted net losses due to severance costs and AI investment
Promotional products revenue more than doubled, offsetting some of the overall revenue decline
Company to continue integrating AI across operations to improve efficiency and profitability
111 Inc plans to expand pharmaceutical product portfolio to consolidate market position
Company expects asset-light transition and cost management to support margin expansion
ASSET-LIGHT TRANSITION - Co said revenue decline was mainly due to strategic shift to asset-light model and divestment of underperforming subsidiaries
PROMOTIONAL PRODUCTS GROWTH - Co said promotional products revenue and gross profit rose sharply due to expanded partnerships and increased sales volumes, especially for Levofloxacin Tablets
COST MANAGEMENT - Co said fulfillment and operating expenses declined, aided by AI-driven workforce streamlining and selective exits from fulfillment centers
